title: On Drift Induced by Local Transition Asymmetry in Combinatorial State Spaces
summary: We study stochastic processes on combinatorial state spaces with local transition constraints, as arise in local search algorithms. We show that asymmetry in local transitions induces a systematic drift in a distance process relative to a reference configuration. This drift results from the imbalance between inward and outward transitions, translating combinatorial multiplicities into directional bias.
